abstract: Pure squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) of the ovary is rare. SCC can arise in a mature teratoma (MT), ovarian endometriosis or in a Brenner tumor. SCC is the most common malignant transformation arising in MT and comprises 80% of all cases. Such neoplastic transformations are extremely difficult either to predict or detect early. The mechanism of malignant transformation has not been completely understood. Due to the rarity and the aggressive course, diagnosis and treatment constitute a big challenge. We report a case of SCC arising in MT presenting with a huge abdominopelvic mass and abundant peritoneal collections clinically masquerading as abdominal tuberculosis. A review of literature with special emphasis on prognosis and treatment modalities is also presented.
abstract_ja: 純粋な卵巣扁平上皮癌(SCC)は稀である。SCCは成熟奇形腫(MT)、卵巣子宮内膜症、またはBrenner腫瘍から発生しうる。SCCはMTから生じる最も一般的な悪性転化で、全症例の80%を占める。このような腫瘍性転化は、予測も早期発見も極めて困難である。稀少かつ進行が攻撃的であるため、診断と治療は大きな課題となる。本報告では、巨大な腹骨盤部腫瘤と多量の腹膜液貯留を呈し、臨床的に腹部結核と誤診された、成熟奇形腫由来のSCC症例を報告する。予後と治療法に特に焦点を当てた文献的考察も併せて示す。
